title: lupinus excubitus subsp. medius
intro: Lupinus excubitus subsp. medius, commonly known as the Bigberry lupine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus excubitus subsp. medius are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
